deferMeshes.h3_skeleton_archer_Rubble: the death shatter's rubble mesh (build_unit.py shatter) is a second SkinnedMeshRenderer; this lane builds exactly one body SMR and the runtime's uvAtlas/Hex/Lit rebind assume one. Without it the body still collapses at the shatter frame, so the death ends in a vanish instead of falling chunks

mergeMeshes.h3_skeleton_warrior_Rubble: the death shatter's rubble mesh (build_unit.py shatter) is merged into the body primitive at prepare (merge_rubble_glb.py): one SkinnedMeshRenderer, the Chunk bones already in its bone list, zero offsets for every corrective morph, so the death breaks into falling chunks in game instead of vanishing
